name: workspace-os
description: The only workspace you will ever need

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node scripts/build-metric-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-collection-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-case-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-mcp-token-cli.mjs
scripts.rebuild:node: npm rebuild better-sqlite3 node-pty && node scripts/sign-native.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/smoke.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:cases: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/cases.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:office: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && for t in A-ribbon B-writer C-export C-tail D-calc; do node e2e/office/$t.mjs || exit 1; done; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:transclusion: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && for t in G-transclusion H-word-transclusion I-ppt-transclusion J-range-transclusion K-docx-table L-pptx-table; do node e2e/office/$t.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; done; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:charts: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/E-charts.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:impresschart: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/P-impress-chart.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:ranges: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/J-range-transclusion.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:contextmenu: node e2e/office/AJ-context-menu.mjs && npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/AK-context-menu-ui.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:parity: node e2e/office/AJ-context-menu.mjs && npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && for t in AK-context-menu-ui AL-canvas-affordances AM-jsdialog AN-menubar AO-review AP-affordances-2 AQ-context-modes AR-animations AS-affordances-3 AT-placements AU-sort-expand; do node e2e/office/$t.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; done; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:tables: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && for t in K-docx-table L-pptx-table; do node e2e/office/$t.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; done; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:lok: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/lok.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:nav: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/nav.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:find: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/M-find-replace.mjs; npm run rebuild:node

scripts.e2e:condformat: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/office/O-cond-format.mjs; npm run rebuild:node

scripts.e2e:agent-pty: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/agent-pty.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:assets: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/created-assets.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:clipboard: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/clipboard.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; npm run rebuild:node

scripts.e2e:shell-layout: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/browser/layout.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:landscape: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && for t in shells stage presence inbox work adoption today library browser-own terminal dark sessions glass-scroll perf; do node e2e/landscape/$t.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; done; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:browser: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && for t in browser-tabs browser/double-load browser/history browser/phase2 browser/phase3 browser/tab-groups browser/share-with-claude browser/address-sync; do node e2e/$t.mjs || { npm run rebuild:node; exit 1; }; done; npm run rebuild:node

scripts.e2e:lok-parts: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/lok-parts.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.e2e:workflows: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node e2e/lok-workflows.mjs; npm run rebuild:node
